Spotting cheat-app (bot) drivers

Scope — HK truck · public-pool · 30d · V2

More ▾

This page is about 143 cheat-app (bot) drivers (3-second rule). We looked at all public-pool truck drivers (van / mudou / mudou9; company orders left out), then kept drivers who drop 2+ different orders in the same 3 seconds. Source: mart_plugin_driver_harm_score_v2. Score = Assigned + Release + Cancel inside this 30d only. Almost every order they released is On Demand (91% On Demand, 5% Same Day, 4% Next Day). Data pulled 2026-08-03, covering 30 days (5 May – 4 Jun 2026).

Driver Review Summary — 30d (5 May – 4 Jun 2026) — 14 Extreme case

More ▾

Who we can score fairly (active drivers)

  • What this means: not just logged in — they took enough trips that we can judge their behaviour
  • Rule: ≥30 orders taken (orders_assigned_30d), ≥30 finished (orders_completed_30d)
  • Period: 30d · 5 May – 4 Jun 2026

Top-tier review

  • 14 drivers in Extreme case (Assigned Extreme · not scored · review alone)
  • Criteria (Version 2): Assigned (0–2) + Release (0–4) + Cancel (0–2) → max 8; Extreme Assigned tier pulled out first

Important note

  • Bot speed (Step 1) finds the pool (3-second rule).
  • Review priority (③) ranks harm inside that pool: Extreme case first, then Assigned + Release + Cancel → max 8.
  • Score = Assigned + Release + Cancel inside this 30d. Source: mart_plugin_driver_harm_score_v2.

Read left → right: everyone on the platform → drivers actually taking trips (not just online) → cheat-app bot speed → highest harm scores for a person to review.

How we count (read this once)

More ▾
Released vs cancelled — Released = driver took the order then released it (event_type_cd = 4, actor_type = 'Driver'). Cancelled = the order later ended with no driver (status = 'cancelled', cd 8 or 11). Pool entry does not require a release.
Who gets a score — in this 30d: must took ≥30 orders (orders_assigned_30d), finished ≥30 (orders_completed_30d), not OA. If any rule fails → outside_analysis_pool (not scored yet; can still work).
Bot pool — 2+ different grace-drops in the same 3 seconds (is_bot_pool_v2). Review bands = Extreme case (not scored) + Assigned (0–2) + Release (0–4) + Cancel (0–2) → max 8.
Orders (booking-type mix on the top) — for the On Demand / Same Day / Next Day share only: each order counted once.

Step 1 (bot detection). Each step filters drivers (not orders). Bar 1 = everyone we checked. Bar 2 = met minimum activity rules. Bar 3 = bot pool by grab-and-drop speed (2+ in the same 3 seconds). Vehicle / Membership filters update these bars.

Bot spotting vs harm scoring — two separate checks

More ▾

Bot spotting ends at the bot pool (bar 3). The 3-second rule — 143 / 3,233 working drivers (4.4%). ③ Review priority then ranks drivers inside this pool (Assigned + Release + Cancel → max 8). (queried 2026-08-03, HK TRANSPORT, 30d 2026-05-05 to 2026-06-04)

③ Review priority of suspected bot drivers — 3 sec · 143 drivers

More ▾

Bot spotting is done. We score the 143 bot drivers (3-second rule). Each driver sits in one review band. Extreme case (14 drivers) comes first — not scored (not in the max-8 sum). Remaining drivers use Review Priority = Assigned (0–2) + Release (0–4) + Cancel (0–2) → max 8 → bands 6–8 / 4–5 / 0–3. Detail: Assigned & Release · Cancel. (queried 2026-08-03, HK TRANSPORT, 30d 2026-05-05 to 2026-06-04)
